main_body: Small barrel with a blue water surface in its open top, a brown wooden rim, grey iron hoops and wooden staves below
top_band: Opening ellipse in rows 3-8 at x=8: brown back rim (row 3), dark blue water (rows 4-5), mid blue water (rows 6-7), light grey-white front rim/hoop highlight (row 8)
evidence: In the column at x=8 the back rim (row 3) is followed by 4 rows of blue water (rows 4-7) with a highlight. A light front-rim line at row 8 closes the ellipse, and a darker brown row 9 sits under it. Below that are the staves with two iron hoops (rows 10 and 13) down to row 14. This matches the guide's green barrel with an ellipse top: the opening is a readable water surface and the front face is a separate vertical body. The only weakness is that the front staves and hoops are painted flat rather than inset.

style.evidence: The side outlines are near-black: 89% of dark edge pixels are neutral, against 1% and 33% for the references. This is the sticker-style outline rather than the dark material tone Beodeul uses. The palette has only 14 distinct colours against 38-40 in the references. Each material (wood, water, iron) gets only about 3 tones, so the shading is shallower than the 5-6 steps in the references. The piece has no flat fills (0% coverage) and its 14 colours per tile is near the references' 17-20. Texture is limited to hoop highlights and staves, with no grain dots or per-stave variation. The black outline and shallow ramps leave it thinner than the references.
